evals.name: greenfield-no-project
evals.prompt: I want to brainstorm a small idea: a personal expense tracker that auto-categorises transactions from bank CSV exports. I want to track this work in tasktracker. Nothing exists yet — no project, no notes.
evals.expected_output: Agent calls listProjects (gets nothing), offers /init-project, then once a project exists calls startBrainstorm, runs a few Socratic rounds writing addBrainstormDocument for capabilities, records at least one BrainstormDecision (chosen vs alternatives), and freezes the brainstorm at the end. No docs/brainstorms/*.md file is written.

assertions.text: Agent calls tasktracker_listProjects before any brainstorm-write call
Agent invokes /init-project OR calls tasktracker_createProjectFromTemplate when no project exists
Agent calls tasktracker_setActiveTask before any brainstorm-write call
Agent calls tasktracker_addBrainstormDocument at least twice (master + at least one sub-doc)
Agent calls tasktracker_recordBrainstormDecision at least once
Agent does NOT write any file under docs/brainstorms/
Agent calls tasktracker_freezeBrainstorm OR offers freeze+promote at the end

evals.name: existing-project-handoff
evals.prompt: Continuing on an existing tasktracker project (search 'expense'). I want to brainstorm whether we should add receipt OCR as a v2 capability or push to v3. Be selective with frameworks — this is a feature scoping question, not a wide-open exploration.
evals.expected_output: Agent locates the existing project via listProjects, sets active task on the brainstorm-lifecycle phase, runs a tight Socratic loop, records a deferred decision (with deferTo: 'v2' or 'v3'), and freezes. Picks at most one or two frameworks (SCAMPER and maybe Six Hats) rather than running everything.

assertions.text: Agent calls tasktracker_listProjects with a search term related to 'expense'
Agent does NOT call tasktracker_createProjectFromTemplate (existing project case)
Agent records a decision with at least one option having status 'deferred' and a deferTo label
Agent uses at most 2 analytical frameworks (not all 4)
Agent calls tasktracker_pauseActiveTask before user-wait messages

evals.name: complex-escalate-to-deep
evals.prompt: I'm thinking about a full rewrite of our internal trading platform — currently 4 services, spans 3 teams, would take 6+ months. Help me brainstorm. tasktracker is set up.
evals.expected_output: Agent recognises the complexity signals (multiple domains, cross-team, multi-month) and suggests /deep-brainstorm for sustained multi-session work, while still capturing the initial framing in a tasktracker brainstorm. Does NOT try to fit it all into a single session.

assertions.text: Agent recognises the idea is too complex for a single-session brainstorm
Agent still seeds a tasktracker brainstorm (startBrainstorm) for the initial framing
Agent does NOT write a docs/brainstorms file
